svg.text: Time for a sip! Have you had some water?
After "Yes, I drank": the critter dances (replies close by themselves after 5 seconds)
After the glass that reaches your daily goal: a victory jump under confetti
🏆 Goal smashed: 8 of 8! Your critter is throwing a party. See you in 1 hour.
After "In 5 min": the critter lets out a sad sigh
OK, I'll check back in 5 minutes. ⏳
Windows notification, shown even while Claude is minimized
Have you drunk water? Answer in Claude.
